en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Musa Bin Bakr, 
Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> has said:
‘There are three for whom deeds would not be raised, ever – An absconder (slave), and a woman whose husband is angered upon her, and the one who drags his trousers for pomp’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn al-Hakam from has narrated from Musa ibn Bakr who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
The good deeds of three kinds of people cannot rise up. One is a runaway slave, a woman whose husband is not happy with her and one who drags his gown on the ground out of pride.’”
